name: 万我仙蛊
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE extremely LONG CENTIPEDE-shaped Gu, several zhang length canonical, whole body appears CAST OF RED COPPER with metallic lustre. A single continuous slender many-segmented reddish-copper body curves in an elongated loose shallow S across portrait, head at lower left and tail rising upper right, whole silhouette and ends inside frame. Head fierce natural centipede MOUTHPARTS (not monstrous humanoid fangs or skull), exactly TWO LONG forehead antennae drifting like smoke. THOUSANDS of minute TRUE FEET on both sides (canonical 5000 each, 10000 total): depict extraordinarily densely packed tiers of tiny articulated red-copper legs, fine comb-like living limbs densely lining the entire side margin, far beyond normal one-pair-per-segment centipede density. Each leg is firm articulated step-leg, NOT soft translucent floating feelers (those belong to Regret Gu). At this viewing scale individual masses of legs read as extremely dense fine bristle-like articulated foot fringe supporting weight, some nearer feet readable as tiny joints and hooks, not ordinary 40 large legs. Red copper organic shell has warm metallic sheen, dense smooth slightly mottled segment plates, nonmechanical; no rivets, gold chains, jewels, flames, runes, masks or ornaments. Subject spans about 75% card height, entirely on a plain muted cool-grey ground plane with tiny stones/grains emphasizing giant long-bodied scale; background low contrast and empty. Raking sidelight reveals copper segments and densely grounded leg fringes with realistic contact shadows. No papery white, crystal legs, multiple worms, detached head, loop coils obscuring body, huge scenery or ordinary insect cute face. Formidable physical copper centipede and extraordinary foot density are identity, not warrior armour.

inspection.verdict: 不可用作最终卡面：赤铜身体成立，但足密度偏普通多足虫，v2定点加强
